decision.selected_method: independent full-task native replay of the fixed quasistatic tension schedule

decision.hypothesis: The unresolved physical uncertainty is whether the current candidate's statically feasible equilibrium path remains dynamically trackable when its fixed interpolated tension schedule is applied through the native actuator and flexible-body dynamics. Competing hypotheses are: (H1) the slow 0.1 Hz motion is sufficiently quasistatic that the schedule tracks the complete figure eight within every frozen acceptance threshold; or (H2) transient dynamics, interpolation between 0.25 s knots, actuator stroke/rate limits, or repeated operation near the 0.2 N unilateral tension floor produce tracking error, drift, or incomplete lobe traversal. T04-216 establishes only sampled mathematical equilibria, T04-217 only time-zero static qualification, and T04-219 only an unmeasured schedule; none establishes dynamic task performance.
decision.expected_observation: Under H1, one independent complete native replay from the candidate-qualified equilibrium using source 826caeba0d084a7aa0062ffd14194112ea115f7cff615ad4c522837fbb9c14b2 completes 22 s without numerical failure, contact, or warnings and satisfies all original T04 limits: RMSE <= 0.003 m, maximum error <= 0.006 m, cycle drift <= 0.002 m, tension in [0.2,8] N, stroke <= 0.03 m, speed <= 0.03 m/s, both y lobes reaching at least -0.018 m and +0.018 m, z extrema spanning at least 0.163 to 0.177 m, and four independent channels.
decision.weakening_observation: H1 is refuted if the complete replay is invalid or violates any frozen threshold, especially phase-dependent error peaks between the 0.25 s equilibrium knots, cycle-two drift above 0.002 m, failure to reach a required lobe extremum, tension clipping/slack at 0.2 N, or actuator stroke/rate violations. Such an outcome supports H2 and distinguishes dynamic/control limitations from the already demonstrated sampled static balance; an incomplete or numerically failed replay leaves the physical cause UNKNOWN.
decision.fixed_conditions: Hold fixed TASK/T04 default exactly: the bound candidate a2b86a9c493cbc5d15bc37f341f86ec0600f418522b41f8e8c8d3de8fc92884f, qualified initial state from T04-217, fixed source schedule from T04-219, gravity, payload and pointer geometry, 22 s timed reference with 2 s start/stop ramps, 0.1 Hz and two cycles, 0.001 s physics timestep, 0.01 s control/sample period, seed 17, native collision policy, evaluator windows, required signals, and every original acceptance threshold. Do not reoptimize control, alter geometry, copy historical qpos, or relax thresholds.
decision.stopping_condition: Stop after this single complete replay is recorded. If every original check passes, the result may support later independent task selection; if any check fails, do not claim acceptance and use the recorded failure mode to choose a later control or design diagnosis. Incomplete evidence remains UNKNOWN.
decision.interpretation: This replay is the smallest feasible experiment that directly discriminates quasistatic sufficiency from dynamic/control failure while using one of the 18 available backend solves. The generated candidate's compilation in T04-210, the equilibrium bank in T04-216, and static qualification in T04-217 establish geometry/materialization and mathematical/static scopes only. The proposed replay has not run; only a complete independent task evaluation can establish physical acceptance for T04.
